priorityList: Interrupt with Pummel whenever the target is casting.
Use Avatar and Colossus Smash on cooldown, ideally synchronized for maximum burst.
Cast Ravager when Colossus Smash has 1.5 seconds or less remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Champion's Spear while either Colossus Smash or Avatar is active on the target.
Cast Bladestorm while the Colossus Smash debuff is active on the target to maximize Slayer procs.
When the target is above 35% health, cast Mortal Strike on cooldown.
In Execute range (target below 35% health), cast Mortal Strike only if you have 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision or Colossus Smash is active.
Cast Execute whenever Sudden Death procs.
In Execute range, cast Overpower if the Opportunist buff is active.
In Execute range, cast Execute if you have 40 or more Rage to maximize damage per hit.
Cast Overpower to generate Rage and build Martial Prowess stacks.
Maintain the Rend bleed on the target, refreshing when it has less than 5 seconds remaining (or 2 seconds during Execute).
Use Slam as a filler if you have excess Rage and no other abilities are available.
